# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 3 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 3
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. He says to them again on this same subject: "Why are you fasting before me?" says the Lord. "Is it so that your voice can be heard today through all your shouting? That is not the kind of fast I have chosen," says the Lord — "not someone merely bowing their head.
2. Not even if you hang your neck down like a bent ring and cover yourself with sackcloth and pile ashes around you — you still cannot call that an acceptable fast."
3. But here is what he says to us: "This is the fast I have chosen," says the Lord: "Break the chains of injustice. Untie the ropes of oppression. Set the crushed free, let them go. Tear up every exploitative agreement.
4. Share your bread with the hungry. Clothe a person when you see them without clothes. Open your home to the homeless. And if you see someone who has been brought low — do not look down on them. Not you, not anyone in your household.
5. Then your light will burst out like the dawn, and your healing will come fast. Your righteousness will walk ahead of you, and the glory of God will wrap itself around you.
6. Then you will call out, and God will answer. While the words are still in your mouth, he will say: 'Here I am.'"
7. Brothers, what an extraordinary gift — that the Lord has shown us all of this and told us plainly what kind of fast he wants. The service of the Lord is good and full of glory, and it comes bearing everything we need.
